trends.name: Claude turns Artifacts and tool integration into distributable products
trends.summary: Claude allows Artifacts to be installed as desktop apps, and uses plugins to unify connectors and skills integration.
trends.attention_driver: Generated outputs can be installed and shared, while tool integration has also been condensed into a unified product entry point.

evidence.quote: artifacts 可创建、运行并分享为独立桌面应用，拥有自己的图标和窗口
evidence.claim: Reports support that Claude allows Artifacts to be distributed as standalone desktop applications.

evidence.quote: Anthropic now lets you install Claude Artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows
evidence.claim: Independent reporting confirms that Artifacts desktop installation covers Mac and Windows.

evidence.quote: MCP 服务器可在工具之外发布技能，按需加载以降低上下文占用。
evidence.claim: Reports support that Claude is expanding tool integration and on-demand skills loading.

trends.so_what: Competition among AI products will extend to the installation, updates, permission revocation and usage analysis of generated outputs, rather than generation quality alone. When designing distributable intelligent applications, teams should include connector authorization and version compatibility in the product lifecycle.

trends.name: GPT-6 cases extend to scientific reasoning and business automation
trends.summary: GPT-6 has specific deployment cases in protein design, sales research and customer service automation, while ChatGPT's default model is also being updated.
trends.attention_driver: Scientific and business cases are appearing at the same time, and updates to the default entry point expand the number of users with access.

evidence.quote: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code.
evidence.claim: Reports support that GPT-6 is used for protein design tasks that require reasoning and code execution.

evidence.quote: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents
evidence.claim: Reports support that the GPT-6 series has entered customer service automation deployments.

evidence.quote: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab
evidence.claim: Reports support that GPT-6.2 Sol is expanding coverage through ChatGPT's default entry point.

trends.so_what: Product teams should redesign acceptance around end-to-end tasks rather than single-turn answers, with a focus on accuracy after tool calls, human takeover rates and completion costs. Models with stable reasoning and code execution can be prioritized for high-value workflows with clear processes.

trends.name: Tidal restricts distribution of fully generated AI music
trends.summary: Tidal says it will ban fully generated AI music and plans to remove about 27 million related tracks.
trends.attention_driver: The platform treats "AI-assisted creation" and "fully generated content" differently.

evidence.quote: AI songs account for 6.3 percent of Tidal's catalog, but it's about to be zero.
evidence.claim: Reports support that Tidal will remove fully generated AI music.

evidence.quote: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.
evidence.claim: Reports support that the platform's policy distinguishes between AI-assisted works and fully generated works.

trends.so_what: Any AI product that relies on content distribution should reserve fields for creative origin, level of human involvement and proof of rights. Review policies need to support tiers based on how content was generated, rather than only determining whether AI was used.

watch_list.name: Open-source releases cover agent runtimes, models and AI data platforms
watch_list.summary: Multiple vendors including OpenAI and OceanBase opened agent runtimes, models or AI data engines during the same period.
watch_list.attention_driver: Open-source supply now covers both the execution layer and the data layer, increasing the components developers can combine.

evidence.quote: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux.
evidence.claim: Reports support that OpenAI and Cisco released an open-source Linux runtime.

evidence.quote: 文心 5.5 Flash Preview正式开源，采用 Apache 2.0 协议
evidence.claim: Reports support that new models are available under the Apache 2.0 license.

evidence.quote: 蚂蚁OceanBase发布湖库一体AI数据平台OceanLake，核心引擎向全球开源
evidence.claim: Reports support a cross-layer supply signal from the opening of an AI data platform's core engine.

watch_list.so_what: Model selection should consider more than reasoning performance. It should also compare licenses, deployment responsibilities and integration costs with existing data systems. As more components become replaceable, product architecture should avoid locking workflows into a single cloud service or model interface.

insights.text: Agent delivery is becoming productized: installable outputs and task-based deployments move acceptance toward permissions, versions and human takeover
Content distribution is starting to demand proof of origin: platforms can treat AI content differently based on human involvement, so provenance fields need to be designed in advance
Competition in tool integration is heating up: 5 new signals focus on MCP and Workspace connectors, and compatibility will affect product selection
